command: set -euo pipefail; S=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; PID=$(systemctl --user show "$S" -p MainPID --value); echo MACHINE=ai-core-node OWNER=gabriel; echo ===SERVICE===; systemctl --user show "$S" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager; echo ===OMEGA_ORGAN_STATUS===; /home/ai-core-node/.local/bin/omega organ-status || true; echo ===PROCESS_TREE===; ps -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,etimes=,cmd= -p "$PID"; pgrep -P "$PID" | xargs -r ps -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,etimes=,cmd= -p; echo ===ESTABLISHED_TCP_FOR_PID_TREE===; PIDS="$PID $(pgrep -P "$PID" | tr '\n' ' ')"; ss -Hntp 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r line; do for p in $PIDS; do case "$line" in *"pid=$p,"*) echo "$line"; break;; esac; done; done; echo ===RECENT_JOURNAL===; journalctl --user-unit "$S" --since '-90 seconds' --no-pager -n 120 2>/dev/null || true; echo FRED_PR133_LIFECYCLE_IDLE_PROBE_DONE
